# Linear Algebra

## Vectors

A vector $\vec{v}$ in $\mathbb{R}^3$ can be written as $(v_1, v_2, v_3)$.

The dot product: $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}||\vec{b}|\cos\theta$

## Matrices

For a $2 \times 2$ matrix:

$$A = \begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$$

The determinant is $\det(A) = ad - bc$.
